credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/chili.py. Reference photo chili/baby.jpg by Paul Zucker (CC BY 3.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Efflorescence_(262728773).jpeg: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: WHITE: the chili flower's petals are genuinely white (shaded inside with the leaf green and split by black). LUNGING. Intro: the flower draws back on its neck and holds, then dips at the foe with the petals flared, recoils and settles; only the flower and the stem tip move. The petals are the real white (index 3), each shaded with a crisp leaf-green crescent. Sport: 'Black Pearl'. Capsicum annuum 'Black Pearl' (USDA, AAS winner 2006): near-black leaves, glossy black fruit, purple flowers (indexes 1-2 only).
